native_identity.method: paired target-minus-contrast; compensated FP64; unit L2 per trunk layer
native_identity.capture: last physical prompt token; FFN branch mean; predictor/decode excluded; fresh unsteered sequences
native_identity.host_budget_scope: owned prompt/index/token/encoding buffers, direction learners and collectors; excludes JSON/stdio/crypto/allocator overhead and executor resources

closure.evidence_scope: Entire recorded container cgroup absent, all actual GPU PID/start_ticks and launcher/supervisor absent; no inferred missing-PID success

numerical_scope: Original last-physical-token FFN branch-major activations, independently rounded branch means, target-minus-contrast and per-layer unit normalization. Response effect and quality not tested.

thermal.peaks_scope: 169 coordinator samples surrounding the owned native child process
thermal.post_native_oracle_sampling_scope: After native GPU retirement the coordinator runs its independent raw-row oracle synchronously. Four saved read-only live observations supplement child telemetry; continuous sampling or an unseen absolute maximum is not claimed for that phase.
